Artur Jorge must make changes at the back, with central defender João Marcelo suspended after picking up his third yellow card, allowing Fabrício Bruno to partner Jonathan Jesus.

                          Gabriel Pec (broken leg) and Luis Sinisterra (thigh) remain on the treatment table, though young midfielder Felipe Morais is back from suspension. William Furtado and Lucas Villalba provide width from full-back, with Lucas Romero and Gerson anchoring midfield. [...] The visitors remain without injured defenders Duplexe Tchamba and Matheus Felipe, as well as midfielder Jáderson. On a positive note, goalkeeper Marcelo Rangel is back from a ban, lining up behind Marcelinho, Zé Ivaldo, Marllon, and Marlon, with Zé Welison, Zé Ricardo, and Patrick forming a combative midfield trio.
